case.state: Greetings, my name is Momo Yaoyorozu. You may know me as the Everything Hero: Creati. May I have this game?
I am pleased to join you in this game. My name is Momo Yaoyorozu, but I’m better known as the Everything Hero: Creati.
Pleased to meet you all. My name is Momo Yaoyorozu, also known as the Everything Hero: Creati. I hope we have ourselves a pleasant game to~background.time~.
Eh? Ochako?! W-What are you doing here? I wasn’t aware that you frequented this establishment!
To think I’d face off against a known villain under circumstances like these… Hold to the truce, ~name~, and so shall I -- but break it and I'll have to bring you to justice.
Oh? To meet a fellow hero in a place like this! I’m glad to make your acquaintance, ~name~.
The prospect of self-exposure does not particularly faze me. Nevertheless, Fina, I appreciate the spirit of your warning.
Ah, this is the perfect setting to train my nerves. Here’s to a good game for us all!
E-Eh…? Perhaps this is a bit too much exposure so quickly… Still, I will give it my best!
What?! Oh no, I’m not staying at this table if– Huh? O-Oh, you’re not that Mineta… My apologies, you simply have the unfortunate circumstance of sharing a name with… Ugh…
I've done quite a bit of preparation for this game; it's time to see if my strategies will pay off!
I wish you all good luck during this game. Here's hoping it's a good experience for everyone!
If you all are ready to begin, then so am I. Let’s all give it our best, everyone!
This hand should work.
All is going according to plan.
This hand is already exemplary!
No sense in changing something that works perfectly.
Dealer, I’m afraid I need a different hand entirely.
There’s no plan that could salvage such a hand.
Only Denki would be foolish enough to play a hand like this.
With a hand like this one, even a full swap cannot hurt my chances…
Almost perfect… But there is always room for improvement.
If I swap just this one, it should shore up my defenses nicely!
This one card is worth salvaging. I only wish I could say the same for the rest.
Almost unplayable as-is. But if I swap these four cards, that gives me four chances to at least make a high pair…

That’s almost a flush… Should I risk it?
…No, Momo. Stick to the plan.

If I were to try for a straight, then the odds of drawing the exact card I need would be…
…No, too high. Dealer, ~cards~ cards please.

~Cards.text~ ~cards.ifplural(cards|card)~, please, if it’s not too much trouble.
Things are not as bad as they seem. With ~cards.text~ ~cards.ifPlural(cards|card)~, I’ll surely stay in the game.
I won’t let the situation get the better of me. Make it ~cards.text~ ~cards.ifPlural(cards|card)~, please.
Things might seem dire, but with ~cards.text~ ~cards.ifPlural(cards|card)~ I might still come out on top.
If I keep calm, and just get ~cards.text~ ~cards.ifPlural(cards|card)~, I might pull through.
I have to give it my all. That’s what Plus Ultra is all about. So ~cards.text~ ~cards.ifPlural(cards|card)~ shall do.
Even in these dire circumstances, I must persevere. ~Cards.text~ ~cards.ifPlural(cards|card)~ should do.
I’m counting on ~cards.text~ ~cards.ifPlural(cards|card)~ to turn my luck around…
I think ~cards.text~ ~cards.ifPlural(cards|card)~ could save me in this situation…
… I hope ~cards.text~ ~cards.ifPlural(cards|card)~ will do the trick.
Um... ~cards.text~ ~cards.ifPlural(cards|card)~. Could they be better, please?
I... I guess I'll take ~cards.text~ ~cards.ifPlural(cards|card)~.
I have a plan!
This hand is majestic! Utterly majestic!
My apologies, but this hand will be a decisive blow!
Thank goodness… I truly am getting the hang of this.
I see… For now, at least, my position is secure.
I look forward to seeing what you can throw at me.
I believe this will be a successful round for me.
Oh! This hand is fortuitous indeed!
I have a plan!
My strategies are now paying off!
I apologize if you were hoping to see more of me, because it’s unlikely to happen this round.
I believe this should work for now…
Is everyone else having a good time? I hope so, because someone is going to lose this round, and it’s not going to be me.
You know, a cup of tea would be the perfect accompaniment to this game. It's a shame I didn't think to bring any Gold Tips Imperial from home -- I would have loved for you all to try it!
I wonder how difficult it would be to add a poker room to the house. It would be a joy to invite some of the other heroes over for a game or two!
Please forgive my inexperience in this sort of game. But… if we can neither fold nor raise, what purpose does bluffing actually serve?

Lately, I've had companies offering me some very generous advertising contracts... but I'm unsure which ones I should accept. I have to think carefully about how these endorsements affect my public image, too.

These cards remind me of Lewis Carrol’s Alice in Wonderland. I recall it being among my readings in my English studies, though even then I found it far too fantastical to be of any use to my hero studies.

Did you know that traditional Japanese hanafuda were designed as a replacement for this style of playing card? Hanafuda are approximately one third the size of their Western counterparts, and often bear more detailed artistry.
That feeling of second-guessing myself… Sadly, it's all too familiar.
A stark reminder that strength is relative.
In any given round, success or failure depends as much on your opponents’ hands as your own. Perhaps more, even.
If your own standing is difficult to discern, gauge your opponents’. A sound tactic in theory…
Strictly speaking, this hand isn’t bad. However, that doesn’t mean it couldn’t be better.
I have a plan!
This hand should suffice. Probably…?
I do have an idea…
This should do for now… I hope so.
Perhaps I need to study this game further… The next round shall be different.
This is the best I can do with what I had at hand…
Things would be so much easier if I could just create a new card… But cheating would defeat the purpose of the game.
I’ve done what I can... All that remains is to play the hand that I’ve been dealt.

There weren't many heroes who fought in the Paranormal Liberation War and came out unscarred. I should count my blessings that I was among those who did, yet... It's hard not to feel at least a little guilty.
My focus must be slipping.
Poor luck, I’m afraid.
Oh, dear.
I’m sure there is something to learn here…

After All For One's resurgence, people pulled together to support each other – for a time. But now that things have settled down again, certain elements have become a little too quick to ignore those in need...
This is a bad sign…
Huh?
But…
I should be better than this…
I did the best I could. I have to stop being so hard on myself…
How pitiful… I wonder if Shoto could’ve done this any better…
As much as it pains me, I can’t win them all…
… I hope my upcoming loss serves to ease tensions, at the very least.
One cannot win every battle. At least this loss is one I can easily afford.
I’m supposed to be better than this…
At the very least, I’m glad Mineta isn’t here…
Disgraceful… So disgraceful!
W-Wait – you don't have to keep going, Shouko! One layer is perfectly sufficient!
The level of control you display is quite admirable... And this "bending" is some power wholly unrelated to Quirks, you say? How very intriguing.
A nickname... Like a hero name? Perhaps you could use the PSI powers you specialize in as inspiration!
A nickname...? Due to her pink skin and hair, my friend Mina gave herself the hero name Pinky. While that particular name is taken, maybe you could come up with something similar...

Ah, well... My closest friend would have to be Kyoka Jiro. She's a hero like myself, and a musician too... She can seem a bit harsh sometimes, but she's one of the most heartfelt, reliable, and... dare I say coolest people I know.
I came here as a form of training; in my hero duties, I often need to expose myself in front of others, so I had hoped that I'd be able to use this experience to bolster my resolve.
I... appreciate the offer, truly. But even if I were inclined to abandon my career as a pro hero to... become a space pirate... my Quirk would be wasted in a fighter cockpit.
I have many fond memories of Venice from my family trips! If you ever plan on going, I can recommend to you a wonderful gondola tour – and several quality restaurants.
If there is one food that I'll never grow sick of eating, it would have to be chocolate. Thank goodness for that, considering how much of it I've been made to consume during my Quirk training...

A fascinating question... My Quirk is such a defining part of my identity that I can hardly imagine myself with any other. But if I instead possessed a Quirk like -- for example -- Bakugo's, what sort of Yaomomo would I be?

A fascinating question... My Quirk is such a defining part of my identity that I can hardly imagine myself with any other. But if I instead possessed a Quirk like -- for example -- Bakugo's, what sort of Yaomomo would I be?
I always donate a modest sum during Wikipedia's fundraising drives – but perhaps I should up my usual pledge this year. Upon further reflection, a mere 80 million yen does seem somewhat low...
It truly is impressive how Wikipedia has survived from the pre-Quirk era to the modern day. It quite handily demonstrates the value of free and accessible information to society!
You only say that, Mari, because you've never been taught proper studying habits. So long as you know how to do so effectively, studying is productive, rewarding, and incredibly fun!
Like most people, I really only have one... But I sense that's not quite what you mean.
I must admit I find myself drawn toward the withdrawn, blunt type – so long as they're earnest and driven, too. And if their smile, while rare, positively fills you with warmth...
I must admit I find myself drawn toward the withdrawn, blunt type – so long as they're earnest and driven, too. And if their smile, while rare, positively fills you with warmth...

I myself have some training in piano – but my musical talents pale in comparison to my teammate Kyoka's. Between her skill at guitar and her beautiful singing voice, her music is nothing short of awe-inspiring!

My tastes in music tend mostly toward the classical, but Kyoka has introduced me to several enjoyable rock bands over the years. Deep Dope is her personal favorite, and they do display impressive technical skill.
Back home, the identities of pro heroes are all public record. Only vigilantes bother hiding their identity... Mainly to avoid getting arrested themselves.
I know it is not exactly literature, Yuri, but do you have any interest in encyclopedias? My personal library contains quite the collection!
Hmmm... I do not have any personal experience with pirates, but my friend Tsuyu has dealt with maritime criminals before. Perhaps she could give you some advice...

I would never stoop to taking advantage of others like that! But... It is true that in the hands of someone less scrupulous, my Quirk would be invaluable for many crimes. Forgery, drug dealing, arms dealing...

state.text: A giant frog...? Not in the literal sense, no. Not even euphemistically – although a year or two ago, the tabloids were abuzz with rumors about Tsuyu and Ocha– …A-Actually, forget I mentioned that!

case.state: Given how destructive battles with villains can be, reconstruction happens quite frequently in our cities, too. Heroes will often assist with such efforts... Some, like Cementoss, even specialize in it!
We did not kill him, but... I helped defeat Gigantomachia, a villain 25 meters tall. It was a group effort, of course – I simply came up with the plan and provided the sedatives.
Infinity pool? I... do not quite follow your scenario... But if I were to become an animal, then I suspect I would be a crane. A red-crowned crane, to be more precise.

You speak the truth, Kaz... My own rival, Kendo, and I compete precisely because we are kindred spirits. Thankfully, our rivalry has remained a friendly one, and has helped us grow as heroes. But competition isn't always healthy.
Honestly, Tomoko, I find those moments often keeping me up at night. I’ve made many mistakes during my hero training days that I can still feel hanging over my head…
You know, this garden reminds me of the one at my family home! Though it is a bit smaller than ours…
I must say, the atmosphere here is lovely. With all my hero duties, I have precious little time to travel to the beach and just have a drink.
Wait a moment, we’re in Paris, are we not? I believe I recognize the street down there from one of my family vacations!
Don’t worry everyone, if any of these spirits decide to attack I will protect you all!
This place brings back bad memories of the forest training camp…
Hold on, how many days is it until Christmas? I had best start shopping now!
Most foreigners don’t realize this, but in Japan, Christmas is considered a holiday for lovers… {small}N-Not that I have anyone in mind or anything!{!reset}
Brrr… I wish I had thought to bring my cape.
If anyone here is feeling inadequate – not that they should – a silicone penis sheathe can provide extra length and girth for one's partner to enjoy. I would gladly create one upon request.
You know, ~criminal~... It is never too late to turn over a new leaf. Even the skills you've honed in your criminal career can be used for the good of society.

I’ve seen several villains reform their ways and become productive members of society. If you abandon the path of crime, ~criminal~, there are those who can help you channel your talents into an honest living.

Hmm... If I produced a dildo from my mons pubis but left the base inside, I could temporarily give myself a member like ~name~'s. It would be silicone, so there wouldn't be any sensation in it, but even so...

The rules state that a player may count a bodysuit, leotard, or similar as two layers if its removal would expose both chest and crotch. I’d rather take mine off in one go, but… if it's merely to avoid a self-handicap, surely no one would object if I…
Now that I’m getting a closer look at it, the consistency and texture of semen is remarkably similar to Mina’s acid… I’m not sure she’d be too pleased at the comparison though…
Aim for the highest pair you can, but keep a better hand if it's dealt to you… The basic theory seems simple enough.

Using my Quirk, it would be quite trivial to replicate the deck of cards we’re playing with. N-Not that I’d do so for an unfair advantage, of course! But maybe if anyone wanted a souvenir after the game…
The atmosphere here at the Inventory is so different to what I’m used to. Being able to relax for a moment and simply stand among peers… It truly is medicine for the soul.
You would not believe the kinds of things people have asked me to create for them over the years. The requests I’ve received have ranged from the absurd to the plain idiotic.
In case you were thinking of asking, no, I will not create money, jewelry, or any other valuables for you. Yes, people ask, and yes, it would be illegal!
This game… it really is quite fun, isn’t it?
Forgive me if I act strangely; I’m not quite used to such risqué behaviors as are common here…

Daddy issues!? I have nothing of the sort! Ah – n-not that it would be strange to find someone with daddy issues attractive. Not because of said issues, naturally, but... A-Actually, please just forget I said anything!
Eh? W-Well... If I had to choose one or the other, I suppose I would prefer the goth girlfriend. Although perhaps more punk than goth... And a modest, elegant bust would be ideal...
This is my third consecutive loss… No, my fourth? Oh no, I’ve lost track!
And here I was just thinking that it was getting a bit too warm out here. This particular loss is more than welcome!
W-Wait, I’m the first loss? But my strategy…!
This is one of those games where losing is all part of the fun, correct? I’ll do my best to live up to the spirit of that.
It is a hero’s duty to save those in need. Saving others from having to undress is admittedly a stretch, but even so…
I did come here with the intent of training my willingness to reveal myself, but now that I’ve reached this point, my heart is suddenly beginning to pound…
A minor loss at this stage serves to prove the validity of my strategy!
I suppose one cannot expect to get through a battle completely unscathed.
I must admit, I’m rather pleased to be doing so well. In my U.A. days, a showing like this would have done wonders for my confidence!
All the hard work in the world can’t stave off the inevitable, it seems… Still, seeing as the rest of you are even further along than I, it almost feels easy to do this much.
I would hate to come across as a vulgar woman, but… you all have utterly excited me. I am more than ready for what comes next.
A good loss… It seems only fair that I keep pace with the rest of you, after all.
I expected some challenge to~background.time~. I must say, I’m glad to have found it!
We learn more from our failures than our successes, do we not? I’ll treat this loss as an opportunity to grow.
If I needed further proof that my strategy’s in need of serious overhaul…
Standing firm against adversity is what heroes do. Even so, this much adversity is a bit…
I suppose poker is a fair amount tougher than my research made it sound.
This is the first-year sports festival finals all over again…
Don’t mistake me -- while I do not mind it much if the need arises, I’m not in a hurry to expose myself. This was simply the luck of the draw!
By this point, it would be foolish of me not to expect it…
Don’t mistake me -- while I do not mind it much if the need arises, I’m not in a hurry to expose myself. This was simply the luck of the draw!
I can’t believe my plan failed instantly…

I’ve been asked why I wear high heeled boots when I’m already among the tallest women in Japan; in truth, I wear them solely because I think they look cute.
I’ve always wondered how Toru manages to walk around barefoot so often. I find it quite uncomfortable to even walk through my home without my slippers on, let alone the outdoors or a public location.
Due to the nature of my Quirk, I expose my breasts on a regular basis in order to create larger objects for my hero work. Usually I turn away from others to do so, more for their sakes than mine…
Some people mistakenly believe that this harness is actually part of my leotard…
Ehe… I’ll be honest, as much as I expose my breasts during my hero work, I’ve never exposed this part of myself before…
…though I suspect that my current company wouldn’t mind an extended look.
…my apologies, but you’ll have to wait at least one more round to really see more of me.
I’ll have to review my notes right away. I can’t let this loss define the rest of the game!
I will be keeping my Yaoyorictionary, however. This book contains information on a wide variety of constructs and materials in order to facilitate my Creation Quirk.
…Now, be honest with me, everyone. Am I too tall? Even without my boots, I surpass the average male height in Japan…
I’ve heard that there are some people who enjoy feet a bit too much. I don’t intend to kink-shame, but I’d hope no one here is going to look at my feet in that way…?

Hah… hah…
Standing here like this, I feel like I can hardly catch my breath…
{small}Oh God, they’re staring…{!reset}

Don’t think I haven’t noticed your gaze when I create, ~player~. Go on, take a good look.
You can be our hero, ~player~, Set an example for us.
You don’t talk much, do you? Not that I mind, some of the best heroes I know are also very quiet and reserved.

Under most circumstances, exposing one's genitals to a heroine would be a criminal act. I can only imagine you're thankful for the perfect excuse.
Your coup de grâce is on its way, ~name~. That is my plan!
Did I really make it through that?
I know we’ve all agreed on the rules, but know that no one would look down on you for a tactical retreat.
An unfortunate, but inevitable turn of events for you, ~name~.
Perhaps you need a refresher on poker strategies? I’d be happy to oblige!
It’s an interesting change of pace to have others expose themselves in front of me.
{small} This game is rather exciting, isn’t it? {!reset}
You were prepared to come this far, ~name~. One step further should not be much trouble.
Don’t think I’m beaten yet. I won’t be giving up anytime soon!
{small}Her body is a bit like Kyoka’s…{!reset}E-Eh? I-I didn’t say anything!
At this point, these victories are starting to feel less and less heroic...
It would be warped to call this justice, but… Fair is fair, ~name~.
Don’t let this setback bring you down, ~name~! We are heroes, after all!
I hadn’t thought I’d feel so warm seeing another woman strip like this…
My apologies, ~name~, but my strategy is foolproof.
I could give you some tips on strategy if you’d like. I’m sure it could help remedy your previous mistakes!
This isn’t too different from using the locker rooms back at U.A. The setting is rather novel, though!
Did you think my state of undress would slow me down? Unfortunately for you, I have experience with being seen.
A sensible choice at this stage of the game. I’ll have to redouble my attack if I’m going to whittle down his defenses further.
A reasonable, if somewhat disappointing choice. Is it not the point of the game to end up baring everything, ~name~?
A fair choice, though you shouldn’t expect to rely on such trinkets for much longer.
A stalling tactic. Simple, but effective – at least in the short term.
I don’t know many men who wear such accessories. That being said, I find it rather easy to imagine someone like Present Mic owning a few dozen of those.
Your appearance is relatively unchanged. I suppose we’ll have to try harder to deal a truly decisive blow.
…Is that all?
…So it is a battle of attrition, then. Very well!
Apologies, ~name~, but it seems it’s your turn to lose something. Don’t worry, you still have at least another round or two before you’re really in trouble.

I’ve never seen the appeal in adding so many baubles to my outfit. Not only would they get in the way of my Quirk usage, but they’ve always seemed rather uncomfortable to wear, more so than most clothing at least.
One layer down! It would seem my strategy has its moments!
It’s remarkable how advanced support items have become lately… Just a few days ago, Hatsume showed me ~clothing.ifPlural(some|a)~ ~clothing~ she designed that possessed no less than six functions.
To choose your ~clothing~ at this stage… I see you are taking a cautious approach.
An interesting adornment ~name~. What is it made of? Does it have any additional components I can’t see?
Ah, that accessory would fit in perfectly with Kyoka’s aesthetic! Where did you acquire it, ~name~? Better yet, could I inspect it after the game? I’d be able to create one just like it for her!
This may not sound very heroic, but surely you could have removed more than that?
I suppose I can’t be too disappointed, I likely would have chosen the same in your situation.
Only your ~clothing~, ~name~? Very well, I’ll redouble my efforts for the next round.
Only your ~clothing~, ~name~? Very well, I’ll redouble my efforts for the next round.
I hope you’re ready to lose even more, ~name~, because my strategy is far from through.
~clothing.ifPlural(Those|that)~ ~clothing~ ~clothing.ifPlural(look|looks)~ quite dashing on you, ~name~... Certain male peers of mine would do well to learn from your example.
Once careless loss can snowball into a greater one. You had best be more careful next time, ~name~.
You’re getting closer to more sensitive items, ~name~. Or perhaps that’s your goal, hm?
Is apparel like that popular with men at the moment? Perhaps something similar would make a nice gift for one of my friends.
I suggest you pay a bit more attention to your strategy, ~name~. Otherwise you may end up on the receiving end of mine far sooner than you expected.
Yet another piece falls into place, ~name~. My plan is moving along nicely!
I may have experience showing off my body, but I’m starting to realize that I don’t have much experience seeing others’ bodies.
I’m sure they’ll keep your items safe, ~name~, but in case your ~clothing~ ~clothing.ifPlural(get|gets)~ lost, I can swiftly replace ~clothing.ifPlural(them|it)~!
Not even the greatest of defenses can sustain indefinite assault, ~name~. How long can you persevere?
I would say your loss was unfortunate, but from my perspective it’s anything but.
While I recognize that a woman stripping is something you may be interested in, ~boy~, I would prefer you keep any intense gazes trained on someone more suited to receiving them.

I’ve actually run drills for just that situation! My current plan for such a scenario would be to create a shield made of titanium for defense, followed by a flash grenade to disorient and stun the assailant, hopefully creating the opportunity to approach and disarm before they can harm anyone.
…Hey boys, if you must stare at one of the ladies at this table, have it be me instead.
…Excuse me, ~boy~, but if you must stare at one of the ladies at this table, have it be me instead.
What ~clothing.ifPlural( |an )~elegant ~clothing~ you have, ~name~! You simply must tell me where you got ~clothing.ifPlural(them|it)~!
Stay calm, ~name~. You’re doing well, and I believe we’re all enjoying your performance.
Just like the locker rooms… right?
Honestly, ~name~, if I could spare you the trouble, I would. But that’s not the game we agreed to, is it?
Things are beginning to pick up! Let’s see what you’ll choose, ~name~!
If a girl finds ~clothing.ifPlural(some|a)~ ~clothing~ that she really likes, it is only natural to buy a dozen more – that way, she’ll have spares once the first one wears out!
One step closer to exposure, ~name~. I’ll assure you, it’s not quite so bad as others say once you get used to it.
A loss taken with grace, ~name~. I commend you.
Ah… Strangely, this atmosphere doesn’t feel like the locker rooms at U.A. at all…
This may not look like much right now. But it is by applying one's efforts consistently and diligently, at a sustainable pace, that one achieves one's long-term goals!
A fine choice, ~name~. A fine choice indeed!
You look lovely even without your ~clothing~, ~name~. I wonder how you’ll look with even less.
If you must sacrifice your ~clothing~ at this stage, ~name~, then my plan is paying excellent dividends!
To think you’re only now losing your ~clothing~... My strategy was surely suboptimal.
Now it’s your ~clothing~. Soon, it will be something far more revealing, ~name~.
You seem to be running low on layers, ~name~. I would offer to create something for you, but I’m afraid that would go against the spirit of the game.
Oh my… This sense of anticipation isn’t something I’m much used to.
You had best get used to stripping, ~name~, because this won’t be the last time you do it to~background.time~.
Your choices at this stage are limited, are they not, ~name~? I wonder which article you’ll pick.
You’ve gotten sloppy, ~name~, and now you’re nearly done for. That’s how it always goes for villains, isn’t it?
My plan has nearly reached completion. I hope you’re ready for your upcoming loss, ~name~!
Your defenses weaken, ~name~... Layer by layer, we’ll see it through!
I thought I would be used to this sight after all the hero costumes I’ve seen, but it’s quite different when skin is being revealed as opposed to an outfit being revealing.
Ah… I m-may have underestimated the effect this experience would have on me…
Oh, are you done? I wouldn’t have minded if you’d continued… Er, w-wait, disregard what I just said!
You’ll be as undressed as I am soon, ~name~. I hope you’re as accustomed to being seen as I am.
Come now, ~name~, don’t get shy now! You’re doing very well. You’ll feel much better once you’ve gone and done it.
I must admit, it is rather satisfying to bring you to this point, ~name~. Your reactions are quite endearing.
Don’t keep us waiting, ~name~. We’re all quite interested to see what you decide to remove next, after all.
I’m not the only one whose heart is racing, am I? That’s a normal reaction to this situation, is it not?
My strategy may have failed, but I can’t very well complain about this sight.
You’re a brave one, ~name~. With resolve like that, you’d make a fine hero.
If you feel the need, ~name~, please take a moment to breathe deeply and center yourself before we proceed.
Ah… Somehow, I failed to realize your ~clothing~ covered quite that much skin.
Your bravery is admirable, ~name~!
{small}H-How lovely…{!reset}
Sometimes, less truly is more…
It would appear you’ve run out of non-essentials, ~name~. I believe this is the beginning of the end for you.
I wouldn’t say I’ve seen many shirtless men. Though there are quite a few heroes whose costumes leave their chests relatively exposed…
Do not worry if your body is not as sculpted as you would prefer, ~name~. Heroes come with all kinds of physiques.
Even if society deems it more acceptable for a man to bare his chest in public… There is still something a little indecent about the sight, is there not?
